title: [LOGGED OUT] Cookie banner is shown on the first visit and "Dismiss" closes it for good

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
Is a banner titled "How we use cookies" shown?
steps.saw: Banner with heading "How we use cookies" at the bottom of the page

steps.text: Does the banner say "We only use essential cookies that allow us to run this service. Read our cookie policy to learn more."?
steps.saw: Text: "We only use essential cookies that allow us to run this service. Read our cookie policy to learn more." (cookie policy is a link)

steps.text: Is the "How we use cookies" banner gone?
steps.saw: Banner no longer on the page (page text has no "How we use cookies")

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store and wait until the page has finished loading.
Is the "How we use cookies" banner still gone?
steps.saw: No banner on the Store page
